args.question: Cobalt Labs (V-976) has one approved invoice, INV-89079, for $15,334.72 due 2026-11-04. Paying it by wire is over the $10,000 threshold, so it needs controller approval under policy. Please confirm the controller has approved this payment, and I will then send the wire for the full amount. (The other Cobalt invoices are INV-35997, already paid, and INV-63537, a draft awaiting approval, which I will not touch.)
